name: UV-based motion parameterization
definition: Transforms query points from world space to canonical space by reparameterizing coordinates as 2D surface-level UV coordinates over time, reducing the dimensionality of the motion field.
summary: UV-based motion parameterization models dynamic human deformation by mapping 3D coordinates to 2D surface UVs and time, reducing dimensionality for faster, memory-efficient learning compared to volumetric methods.
